# Code from RiftLinux

- `riftlinux_openxr_hdr_test.cpp`: RiftLinux's native HDR test application (`riftlinux-openxr-hdr-test`), copied
  unchanged from RiftLinux 0.1.3 (https://github.com/AIIX/RiftLinux, `src/xrt/targets/openxr_hdr_test/`, BSL-1.0).
  Built here as the reference picture for comparing Rift Home's HDR output with the runtime's own.
- `../openxr/openxr/XR_MNDX_composition_layer_hdr.h`: the runtime's provisional HDR layer extension header (BSL-1.0),
  see the provenance note in the file.
